title: Nimble Roasted Polish Papelon Skewers
description: A traditional Polish dish featuring roasted papelon, this recipe is a low-calorie and flavorful showstopper, perfect for any occasion. It is made with a tempering process to achieve a flaky texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the oil mixture.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the oil mixture.
Thread the chicken and onion mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in a large wok and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the wok from the oven and add the shredded papelon to the wok.
Return the wok to the oven and continue to roast for an additional 10 minutes, or until the papelon is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the wok from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
